import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    static final int Maxn = 10;
    static final long mod = (long) 1e9 + 7;
    static long qp(long x, long p) {
        long ret = 1;
        while (p > 0) {
            if (p % 2 == 1) ret = (ret * x) % mod;
            x = (x * x) % mod;
            p >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    static long inv(long x) {
        return qp(x, mod - 2);
    }

    static int[][] p = new int[Maxn][Maxn];
    static int n;
    static int[] id = new int[64];
    static int ki;

    static long[] Y = new long[1048576];

    static void add(long[] x, long y) {
        x[0] = (x[0] + y) % mod;
    }

    static void sub(long[] x, long y) {
        x[0] = (x[0] - y + mod) % mod;
    }

    static void FWT(long[] P, int opt) {
        int N = 1048576;
        for (int i = 2; i <= N; i <<= 1) {
            for (int p = i >> 1, j = 0; j < N; j += i) {
                for (int k = j; k < j + p; k++) {
                    if (opt == 1) add(P, k, P[k + p]);
                    else sub(P, k, P[k + p]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {

        if (n < 6) {

                p[i][i] = 1;
            }
            n = 6;
        }
        int A = (1 << 6) - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(i) == 3) {
                id[i] = ki++;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); i++) {
            int msk1 = i & A, msk2 = i >> 6 & A, msk3 = i >> 12 & A;
            int mask = 0;
            long pp = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if ((msk1 >> j & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[0][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[0][j])) % mod;
                }

            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {

                    pp = (pp * p[1][j]) % mod;
                } else {

            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if ((msk3 >> j & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[2][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[2][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            if (p.length == 0) continue;
            for (int a = 0; a < 6; a++) {
                if ((msk1 >> a & 1) == 1) {
                    for (int b = 0; b < 6; b++) {
                        if (a == b) continue;
                        if ((msk2 >> b & 1) == 1) {

                                if (a == c || b == c) continue;
                                if ((msk3 >> c & 1) == 1) {

                                    mask |= 1 << id[nmsk];
                                }

                    }

            }
            add(X, mask, pp);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); i++) {
            int msk1 = i & A, msk2 = i >> 6 & A, msk3 = i >> 12 & A;
            int mask = 0;
            long pp = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
